subject: pe
title: What is VO2 Max?
welcome_lead: Maximum oxygen uptake — the gold standard of aerobic capacity.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on VO₂max, measurement and physiological determinants.
final_note: VO₂max is heart × blood × muscle multiplied together — each component is trainable.

concepts.def: Maximum rate of oxygen consumption during incremental exercise (mL kg⁻¹ min⁻¹).
Difference in O₂ content between arterial and venous blood.
Gas analysis during ramped exercise to exhaustion.
Predicts VO₂max from sub-max HR response (e.g., Astrand cycle test).
Adjusted for body mass (mL kg⁻¹ min⁻¹); body-mass-comparable.

walkthroughs.body_html: VO₂max is reached when O₂ uptake plateaus despite increasing workload — the gold standard of aerobic fitness.
VO₂ = Q × (a-v)O₂. Endurance training increases SV (Q) and (a-v)O₂ difference simultaneously.
Direct gas analysis on treadmill/cycle is gold standard. 12-min Cooper run and bleep test estimate.

options: Maximum rate of O₂ consumption
